|Aerial bug of the Citadel, unarmed but for its short horn.<hr/>
For this bug to have survived Pharloom's climb it must have teamed with stouter companions. I cannot imagine it succeeding alone.

<b>Choir Flyers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Winged Pilgrim]]s that have become part of [[the Choir]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Choir Flyers behave similarly to their Pilgrim counterparts, hovering at a distance from Hornet and then moving in to charge forward at her, dealing {{Damage|1}}. Needle Bouncing and ranged attacks are most effective against them.

Choir flyers deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

A Choir Flyer with 40 HP appears west of the [[Bellway]] fighting [[Second Sentinel]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* To live eternal... in the light...
* I am chosen!
* Your ringing halls...
* Your shining walls...
* The song...
* Where is the song?
* When may I rest?
* Is this the way?
* None shall starve...
* None shall die...
}}

== Location ==
Choir Flyers can be found throughout the [[Choral Chambers]]. They also appear during enemy gauntlet at the entrance to [[Whispering Vaults]], accessible from [[Cogwork Core]].
